_provenance.panel_purpose: Substrate-controlled HENI validation. Each entry pins a published Stylianou per-food HENI value (minutes of healthy life per serving) so the FNDDS-substrate computation can be compared like-for-like to the source paper.
_provenance.stylianou_source: Stylianou et al. 2021, Nature Food 2:616-627; figures and SI tables cited per-entry.
_provenance.seed_source: Initial seven entries lifted from backend/_smoke_heni_cnf_vs_wweia_substrate.py where the published values were already cited and traceable.
_provenance.minutes_per_udaly_source: Stylianou et al. 2021 SI p. 98 (US life expectancy at birth, average 2010-2020).

fig4_population_reference.source: Stylianou 2021 Results p. 619; n = 5853 foods scored across NHANES food supply.
